summary: Iter 67 — Holerite IA (Claude) + public collaborator holerites: ALL CRITICAL FLOWS PASS. Backend 10/10 tests pass (pytest). Frontend admin AI import modal opens, parses real PDF in ~9s via Claude (3/3 funcionários, 100% scores, CPF exato + Nome alta), KPIs and review UI render correctly. Collaborator mobile app kebab → 'Meus holerites' opens MyHoleritesModal, lists holerite (R$ 3.015,00) and 'Baixar PDF' opens PDF in new tab.

issues: Recurring console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' for several Recharts containers — purely cosmetic, no UX impact

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Fix Recharts width/height=-1 warning by ensuring container has minWidth/minHeight when chart mounts before layout settles.
(Optional) Add data-testid attributes on Holerite IA modal step rows (e.g. match row, ignorar checkbox, select) to enable deterministic Playwright tests in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/holerite.py is 850 lines — consider splitting holerite_ai endpoints into a separate router file for maintainability.

ai-import endpoint duplicates the same PDF bytes per matched employee onto disk (one physical file per employee). For large rosters this wastes storage; recommend using a single shared file_uuid referenced by all docs, with file_path reuse.
Threshold validation in ai-parse uses int(threshold) but FastAPI Form(int) already coerces — minor redundancy.
No automatic cleanup of /drafts/*.pdf nor holerite_ai_drafts collection; recommend TTL index or periodic cleanup job to honor LGPD minimization.
seed_data_creation: ai-import test deliberately skip=True for all items to avoid DB pollution. The pre-existing 4 payroll_documents (1 manual + 3 AI from previous run) are kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Holerite IA is fully functional end-to-end. PDF /tmp/holerite_teste.pdf still available (3 funcionários — Diogo, Junior, Jefferson). Frontend admin modal has stepper 'Upload→Analisar→Revisar→Importar', KPI cards work, match badges render (CPF EXATO / NOME ALTA visible in screenshot). Mobile kebab item testid='kebab-holerites' working. Public endpoint test_public_file_stream confirms PDF binary streamed with correct Content-Type. Claude parsing takes ~9-13s.
